## Summary

One-paragraph description of the feature.

## Defensive use case

Explain how this helps a user audit **their own** system. Features
that primarily benefit offensive use of the tool will be rejected.

## Suggested implementation

If you have an idea of how to implement it, sketch it here. Otherwise
leave blank.

## Existing alternatives

Have you tried to achieve this with existing tools (LaZagne,
pypykatz, mimikatz, ...)? What were the limitations?

## References

Any public research or documentation that supports this feature.

## Confirmation

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

      payloads.
- [ ] This feature does not enable unauthorised access to third-party
